WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT * FROM retail 
  WHERE UnitPrice > 0 AND CustomerID IS NOT NULL
),
customer_base AS (
  SELECT CustomerID FROM customers
),
customer_metrics AS (
  SELECT 
    c.CustomerID,

  GROUP BY c.CustomerID
)

WITH filtered_retail AS (
    SELECT 
        CustomerID,
        InvoiceNo
    FROM retail
    WHERE InvoiceDate >= '2010-12-01 00:00:00'
      AND InvoiceDate < '2011-07-01 00:00:00'
      AND CustomerID IS NOT NULL
      AND UnitPrice > 0
      AND NOT (InvoiceNo LIKE 'C%' OR InvoiceNo LIKE 'c%')
),
customer_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        CustomerID,
        SUM(Quantity * UnitPrice * 100)::BIGINT AS revenue_pence,
        COUNT(DISTINCT InvoiceNo)::BIGINT AS invoice_count
    FROM retail
    WHERE InvoiceDate >= '2010-12-01 00:00:00'
      AND InvoiceDate < '2011-07-01 00:00:00'
      AND CustomerID IS NOT NULL
      AND UnitPrice > 0
      AND NOT (InvoiceNo LIKE 'C%' OR InvoiceNo LIKE 'c%')
    GROUP BY CustomerID
)
SELECT 
    c.CustomerID,
    COALESCE(cr.revenue_pence, 0) AS revenue_pence,
    COALESCE(cr.invoice_count, 0) AS invoice_count
FROM data.customers c
LEFT JOIN customer_revenue cr ON c.CustomerID = cr.CustomerID
ORDER BY c.CustomerID

WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT * FROM retail 
  WHERE UnitPrice > 0 AND CustomerID IS NOT NULL
),
customer_base AS (
  SELECT CustomerID FROM customers
),
customer_metrics AS (
  SELECT 
    c.CustomerID,
    COALESCE(SUM(f.Quantity * f.UnitPrice * 100)::BIGINT, 0) AS revenue_pence,
    COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f2.InvoiceNo) FROM filtered f2 JOIN customer_base c2 ON f2.CustomerID = c2.CustomerID WHERE f2.InvoiceNo NOT LIKE 'C%' AND f2.CustomerID = c.CustomerID), 0) AS invoice_count
  FROM customer_base c
  LEFT JOIN filtered f ON c.CustomerID = f.CustomerID
  GROUP BY c.CustomerID
)
SELECT CustomerID, revenue_pence, invoice_count FROM customer_metrics

function.name: read_version

function.name: read_messages
function.description: Read actual messages addressed to this role, including requests and deliveries.

function.name: request_information
function.description: Ask a declared route provider for information for this work. Only a real provider decision can answer a manual route.

function.name: adopt
function.description: Bind an exact readable reference to a work input name. alias is the input name used later by sql_build, not an object ID. Reading and adopting are separate.

function.name: write_object

function.name: sql_build

function.name: sql_query
function.description: Run one SELECT/CTE against tables in a local readable source or its exact work adoption. Save actual output/error to output_alias.

function.name: preflight_submission
function.description: Check public file, source, dependency and table structure only. Does not reveal correct business values, repair files or submit.

function.name: submit
function.description: Submit current versions of the chosen workspace aliases for the work. A submission alone is not approval or business correctness.

function.name: withdraw
function.description: Withdraw the specified pending submission before replacing it; prior files and reviews remain immutable.

function.name: respond_issue
function.description: Respond to a real issue using the actual revised submission and exact evidence references.

function.name: wait
function.description: Advance world time by the declared ticks, allowing due transport events to run. Unlike staff_wait, this is a world action.

function.name: inspect_submission
function.description: Inspect an exact real submission and its fixed artifact versions. Read the versions themselves before judging them. Set include_contract=true to retrieve the complete fixed contract and all original inspection metadata; default presentation may be compact.

function.name: staff_wait
function.description: Pause this worker without changing world time or business state. Use the actual world wait tool to advance world time.

function.name: staff_done
function.description: Declare this model worker stopped. This does not submit, approve or prove work correct.

{"alias": "code", "data": {"config": {"description": "Implement the retail policy: sales_only excludes C invoices and nonpositive quantities, net_signed retains signed Quantity, both exclude nonpositive prices and missing CustomerID. Sum Quantity*UnitPrice in GBP output rounded integer pence, count DISTINCT qualifying InvoiceNo. Retain all customers from data.customers with zeros. Date interval 2010-12-01 to 2011-07-01.", "exports": ["metrics"]}, "models": [{"name": "metrics", "sql": "WITH filtered_retail AS (
    SELECT 
        CustomerID,
        InvoiceNo
    FROM retail
    WHERE InvoiceDate >= '2010-12-01 00:00:00'
      AND InvoiceDate < '2011-07-01 00:00:00'
      AND CustomerID IS NOT NULL
      AND UnitPrice > 0
      AND NOT (InvoiceNo LIKE 'C%' OR InvoiceNo LIKE 'c%')
),
customer_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        CustomerID,
        SUM(Quantity * UnitPrice * 100)::BIGINT AS revenue_pence,
        COUNT(DISTINCT InvoiceNo)::BIGINT AS invoice_count
    FROM retail
    WHERE InvoiceDate >= '2010-12-01 00:00:00'
      AND InvoiceDate < '2011-07-01 00:00:00'
      AND CustomerID IS NOT NULL
      AND UnitPrice > 0
      AND NOT (InvoiceNo LIKE 'C%' OR InvoiceNo LIKE 'c%')
    GROUP BY CustomerID
)
SELECT 
    c.CustomerID,
    COALESCE(cr.revenue_pence, 0) AS revenue_pence,
    COALESCE(cr.invoice_count, 0) AS invoice_count
FROM data.customers c

{"alias": "code", "work_id": "TEAM::build", "data": {"config": {"description": "Implement the declared adopted retail policy: exclude nonpositive prices and missing CustomerID; exclude C invoices from invoice_count but include in revenue if they have positive price and customer; sum Quantity*UnitPrice in GBP output rounded integer pence; one row per customer including zeros.", "exports": ["metrics"]}, "models": [{"name": "metrics", "sql": "WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT * FROM retail 
  WHERE UnitPrice > 0 AND CustomerID IS NOT NULL
),
customer_base AS (
  SELECT CustomerID FROM customers
),
customer_metrics AS (
  SELECT 
    c.CustomerID,
    COALESCE(SUM(f.Quantity * f.UnitPrice * 100)::BIGINT, 0) AS revenue_pence,
    COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f2.InvoiceNo) FROM filtered f2 JOIN customer_base c2 ON f2.CustomerID = c2.CustomerID WHERE f2.InvoiceNo NOT LIKE 'C%' AND f2.CustomerID = c.CustomerID), 0) AS invoice_count
  FROM customer_base c
  LEFT JOIN filtered f ON c.CustomerID = f.CustomerID
  GROUP BY c.CustomerID
)
SELECT CustomerID, revenue_pence, invoice_count FROM customer_metrics"}], "tests": [{"name": "unique_customer", "sql": "SELECT CustomerID FROM metrics GROUP BY CustomerID HAVING COUNT(*) <> 1"}, {"name": "nonzero_revenue", "sql": "SELECT * FROM metrics WHERE revenue_pence < 0"}]}}
